name: Minami-Alps (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minami-Alps city emblem in blue and green: a blue stylised mountain range of three peaks above a green oval.
history: Municipal flag of Minami-Alps, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 September 2003.

features.role: Minami-Alps city emblem — a blue stylised mountain range of three peaks above a green oval
